title: Mascot animation clips (Claude-written) for tools/blender/build_actions.py
description: Key poses per bone or morph target, eased with named presets, with holds, time offsets (overlap) and chains. Semantics: tools/blender/README.md#animation-json. Frames are at `fps` (30 per ANIMATION_CONTRACT). A key's `ease` shapes the motion ARRIVING at that key.

rig.description: Free text: which rig/.blend this was authored against.

anyOf.description: Preset like BACK_OUT, ELASTIC_OUT, BOUNCE_OUT, SINE_IN_OUT, QUAD_IN, EXPO_OUT, LINEAR, CONSTANT, BEZIER, or an alias: STEP/HOLD, SMOOTH, EASE, ANTICIPATE, OVERSHOOT, SETTLE, SNAP, DROP, THUD.

amplitude.description: ELASTIC wobble size as a fraction of the segment's change (default 1.0).

period.description: ELASTIC period in frames (default: 30% of the segment).

v.description: rot: [x,y,z] degrees; loc: [x,y,z] metres; scale: [x,y,z] or s; squash: sy (sx = sz = 1/sqrt(sy)); morph: weight 0..1.

hold.description: Hold this value for N frames before moving on (2-4 frame holds sell a pose).

chain.description: Bones root->tip; expands into one track per bone.

offsetStep.description: chain: extra frames of delay per link (follow-through). Default 2.

falloff.description: chain: amplitude multiplier per link. Default 1.

morph.description: Shape key name (e.g. surprised); every mesh that has it unless `mesh` is given.

space.description: rot/loc axes. world (default): Blender world axes at the base pose; the character faces -Y, +Z is up. local: the bone's own axes.

offset.description: Shift the whole track by N frames (overlap). Wraps around on loops.

loopEase.description: Ease of the auto-added closing key on loops.

anyOf.description: 'rest' or the name of an existing action to take the base pose from (frame 0).
